# 2 Baruch Chapter 67 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**67:1** "And-those-bright-waters which-you-saw which-followed: these-are-the-fountain-of-Jeremiah the-prophet, and-of-those-who-were-like-him in-his-time."

**67:2** "For-Jeremiah spoke-many-prophecies, and-he-prayed-for-the-LORD, that-the-wrath-might-be-appeased; and-he-built-a-monument-to-the-righteous, and-he-fasted-many-days."

**67:3** "He-spent-his-life in-grief; and-when-Jerusalem was-captured, he-wept-bitterly; and-he-composed many-lamentations-of-Zion."

**67:4** "And-he-said-to-the-people that-the-end-would-come-upon-them because-of-their-sins; and-he-told-them in-advance the-captivity-of-the-exiles."

**67:5** "And-when-Nebuchadnezzar came, he-was-not-afraid; and-when-the-city-was-taken, he-was-sent-with-the-exiles to-Babylon; and-afterwards he-returned, and-he-lamented-over-Zion."

**67:6** "These-are-the-sixth-bright-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
